name: Low-Sodium Hospital Diet (2,000 mg/day)
description: Limits sodium per day and per meal, and blocks very salty foods. Example limits for learning; confirm with a registered dietitian.

rules.message: Each day should include breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
Total sodium for the day must not go over 2,000 mg.
rules.source: WHO guideline: Sodium intake for adults and children (2012) - less than 2 g sodium per day

rules.message: Sodium in one main meal must not go over 700 mg.
rules.source: Institutional example value (about one third of the daily limit)

rules.message: Sodium in one snack should stay at or below 200 mg.
Very high-sodium foods are not allowed on this diet.
Limit or replace high-sodium condiments (soy sauce, fish sauce, shrimp paste).
